### 1. Project

Ref HC-ARTHUR-RFP · Issued 2026-10-12 · Closes 2026-10-30 · Contact Project manager, pm@example.com

Hale Capital intends to extend Warehouse (Class 7b) and Mezzanine office (Class 5) at 145-151 Arthur St, Homebush West NSW (Strathfield).

| Project | Detail |
|---|---|
| Building | Warehouse: Class 7b, 2,135 m² GFA; Mezzanine office: Class 5, 215 m² GFA |
| Quantities | Site 31,720 m² · Gross floor area to be confirmed |
| Planning pathway | Development application (DA) |
| Procurement | Traditional lump sum |
| Site conditions | Work to an existing building; Parts with different NCC classes; Building over or next to a water authority asset; Existing on-site detention to keep or modify; Use generates heavy vehicle movements |
| Information provided | 12 current documents in the project register, listed in the issue record |

### 2. Your role

Lead design consultant: you coordinate the consultants and integrate their work into your documents. You are not responsible for the accuracy of their work. The client engages the other consultants directly: Structural (to be appointed), Civil (to be appointed), Traffic (to be appointed), Town Planner (to be appointed).

### 3. Scope by stage

Price each stage that applies. Each stage ends at client sign-off, and that design is the basis for later stages (section 6). Options are priced on their own and are not in the base fee.

| Stage | Deliverable at sign-off |
|---|---|
| Concept | Site inspection; review of existing information and brief gaps; up to 2 options; preferred concept; area schedule; check against budget |
| Schematic design | Preferred scheme resolved for planning and the cost plan; outline materials and systems; pre-application meeting where the pathway has one |
| Planning approval | Architectural drawings and input to the Statement of Environmental Effects: one preliminary and one final issue; lodged by others |
| Planning response | Authority information requests and design changes during assessment; actual time at R3 rates up to 20 hours |
| Design development | Coordinated design to the approval and consent conditions; finishes and typical details; BCA strategy with the BCA consultant |
| Interiors | Interior layouts, finishes and joinery for the base building and common areas |
| Tender documents | Documents complete enough to price as a lump sum: drawings, schedules and specification; one tender issue. You hold the whole architectural design. |
| Bidding | Tenderer questions and addenda; actual time at R3 rates up to 40 hours |
| For-construction documents | Negotiated changes incorporated; non-typical details; one for-construction issue and one construction certificate issue; design certification for the construction certificate. You hold the whole architectural design. |
| Design support during construction (option) | 6 site inspections; RFIs; shop drawing review; practical completion and defects inspections. A later stage the client may commission. |
| Contract administration (option) | Superintendent or contract administrator under the construction contract: progress claims and variations assessed, practical completion and defects certification. Price as an option: the client has not decided who administers the construction contract. |

### 4. Allowances

Price exactly these. Work beyond an allowance needs a written instruction (section 6) and is then charged at your R3 rates.

| Item | Allowance | Item | Allowance |
|---|---|---|---|
| Design meetings | 4 per stage, online or in person | Concept options | 2 |
| Client presentations | 2 | Working 3D views | 1 |
| Issues per stage | 1 draft and 1 final | Site visits, design stages | 2 |
| QS cost plan reviews | 3, at schematic, design development and pre-tender | BIM level of detail | LOD 300 |
| Drawing sheets at planning | 12, indicative; list them in R2 | Planning response ceiling | 20 hours |
| Bidding ceiling | 40 hours | Construction site inspections | 6 |

### 5. Scope position

Service levels are set for a complex project (Class 5, Mezzanine office); technical items follow the project's own facts.
Included in the fee: Coordinating and integrating consultants' work; Brief gaps, required-input schedule, responsibility matrix and decisions register; Specialist inputs (energy, access, fire, façade) shown in your documents; designer and certifier noted per interface; BIM model issued to the design team (level in section 4); Architectural specification; Door schedule; hardware schedule by the supplier; External and base-building finishes schedules; Interior layouts for typical rooms; Base-building and common-area interiors; Liaison with the certifier; Uploading to the client's document system; Existing building: retain, demolish and alter drawings; investigations needed; old-to-new interfaces; Class and use map by part; shared-system interface schedule; shell versus fit-out deliverables.
Optional: price each on its own line in R1: Help selecting other consultants; BIM coordination meetings, clash detection; Tenant fit-out design; Loose furniture and FF&E selection; Photoreal renders, marketing CGI, models; Value management redesign (at R3 rates); Tender evaluation input; Modification applications after approval; Community consultation (if community consultation is required); Connecting with Country input (if Connecting with Country input is required); Green Star or NABERS documentation (if a Green Star or NABERS target is set); Signage and wayfinding; As-built or record drawings.
Excluded: the party named does it: Court appeals (client (separate engagement)); Façade performance certification (NCC Part F3) (façade engineer, not yet engaged); Performance solutions (fire, access, weatherproofing) (fire and access engineers, not yet engaged); Work outside the site boundary; external hardstands (civil engineer, to be appointed); Authority and other consultants' fees (the client).
Tell us in R6 if you disagree with any line. Do not add your own general exclusions; any you add are treated as non-compliant.

### 6. Terms

- Engagement is under AS 4122-2010 as amended by the client's special conditions (attached); your own terms do not apply. List any change you propose to the agreement in R6.
- Only a written instruction from the client's representative authorises extra scope, work beyond an allowance or a fee change; work without one is not paid.
- Each stage ends at client sign-off, which sets the baseline for later stages. Design development within the brief is not a variation; a client change after sign-off is assessed under the agreement.
- Correcting your own errors, or coordinating with information you were given, is not a variation.
- Invoice monthly against stage progress; payment within 30 days, not dependent on any authority approval.
- Your proposal stays valid for 90 days.
- Questions in writing to Project manager, pm@example.com by 2026-10-23; answers go to every tenderer as numbered addenda.

### 7. Evaluation

Price 40% · Relevant experience 20% · Team 20% · Methodology and program 10% · Compliance with the returnable schedules 10%. Lowest price does not automatically win.

R3 Hourly rates: Excl. GST, for work authorised in writing beyond the allowances. Roles: Principal or Director · Associate or Senior architect · Project architect · Architect · Graduate or Technician · Interior designer · Administration.
R4 Team: Named lead, % time by stage, subconsultants; resources must match R7. Named director, project lead and project architect, with registration numbers.

### Before issue — resolve or accept

**Rules await owner review**: The architectural services rules are a draft. Drafting and editing work; issue stays blocked until the owner marks them reviewed.

**Blocks issue — Gross floor area: sources disagree (2135 vs 2895)**: Set the one figure every firm prices from.

**Unallocated: Façade performance certification (NCC Part F3)**: Excluded from this RFP, but the project has no façade engineer package. Add one or name who does it.

**Unallocated: Performance solutions (fire, access, weatherproofing)**: Excluded from this RFP, but the project has no fire and access engineers package. Add one or name who does it.

**Live institutional or industrial site: not established**: Left out until confirmed: Staged access, temporary services and occupation inputs agreed with the operator.
